note: R1-R6 are the series resistors, R7-R12 the pull-downs. Resistors are compared by reference only, not by pad number, because a resistor is symmetric and pad 1 depends on symbol rotation. See check_nets.py.
footprint_note: Written 2026-09-14, BEFORE the footprints are assigned, so this map is the to-do list and the test at the same time. ERC cannot do this job: R1-R12 all declare the filter `R_*`, which matches the 0805 and the axial through-hole footprint equally, so swapping the series resistors with the pull-downs passes ERC silently. Verified present in KiCad 10.0.6. The parts decide the final word: measure the resistor body and lead pitch on arrival before freezing R1-R6.
